::: {#exm-alphabet}
#### Three alphabets

Each of these sets is an alphabet (@def-alphabet):

- $\cb{0, 1}$, the two binary digits;
- $\cb{\mathtt{A}, \mathtt{C}, \mathtt{G}, \mathtt{T}}$, the four bases of DNA;
- $\cb{\mathtt{a}, \mathtt{b}, \ldots, \mathtt{z}}$, the 26 lowercase letters of English.

The set of all integers is not an alphabet, because it is not finite.

:::
